lock_policy: Dated official pick files are append-only. A published pick is never changed or removed once it is on the card. New picks CAN be appended during the day as they qualify — pitcher strikeout picks require the real posted starting lineup, which for a late game does not exist until the early evening, so the card is expected to grow as the slate progresses.
note: Official records are separated by market. Moneylines use the 61% probability and 7.2/10 Lab gates; game totals are currently paused while the totals setup rating is rebuilt (see EXP-20260727-01); pitcher Ks use a 0.7-K edge, posted price, two-book coverage, a confirmed non-opener workload, and the real posted starting lineup (not a projected one). No market publishes an official pick at a price of -185 or shorter — a favourite that heavy has to win 64.9% of the time just to break even, and Leo's graded record does not support paying that.

labScoreBreakdown.note: Lab Rating grades Leo's analysis quality only. It contains no market or price input.

pick_team.label: Normal
pick_team.workload_read: Manageable recent workload. Bullpen should still be part of the full-game read.
pick_team.score_reason: Normal (4.7/10): 8.7 recent relief innings, recency-weighted (2 days since last game), 5 arms worked back-to-back days. Recent innings count more; rest days lower the score. Workload only — see efficiency for how well the pen has pitched.
pick_team.formula: 45 + (recency-weighted (BP IP - 3/game) x 4.2) + (recency-weighted back-to-back arms x 8). Each game decays by half every 2 days, so rest days lower the score.

context_only.note: Reliever counts are displayed for context only and do not add score points.

pick_team.efficiency_reason: Dominant (8.0/10): 1.04 ERA and 0.58 WHIP over 8.7 relief innings (1 ER, 2 H, 3 BB) in the last 7 days.
pick_team.efficiency_formula: 50 - clamp((ERA - 4.20) x 6, -25, 25) x confidence - clamp((WHIP - 1.30) x 15, -20, 20) x confidence, confidence = clamp(BP IP / 6, 0.35, 1)

moneyline.why: New York Yankees is an official moneyline pick because it clears both gates: 72.1% model win probability and 8.1/10 Lab Rating. Leo projects 72.1% against a 54.0% no-vig market number, a 18.1% model edge at -124. New York Yankees owns the starting pitcher edge by 24 points. Bullpen read: Neutral. New York Yankees's pen efficiency: Dominant (8.0/10). Lineup check: New York Yankees is a touch below its season form (-0.020 OPS); Tampa Bay Rays is in a cold stretch (-0.087 OPS). Recent form supports this side and is included in the unified run projection.
moneyline.risk: No model can see every live lineup, injury, or late bullpen availability update. Recheck official news before first pitch.
